blocks.text: Why use Collagen in our Massage
blocks.html: Why use Collagen in our Massage

Massage keeps skin firm by improving blood flow and stimulating fibroblasts, which are the cells that help produce connective tissues, such as collagen and elastin, that keep skin firm and smooth. Adding collagen peptides to your massage enhances the skin firming effect, giving skin all over a beauty boost! Helps your skin looks smooth and glow too!

Our therapists perform a firming massage across targeted areas of your body. These techniques are meticulously designed to stimulate circulation, encouraging the absorption of collagen and other beneficial ingredients deep into the skin layers.

As the massage progresses, circulation is improved, facilitating the delivery of nutrients and oxygen to the skin cells. This increased blood flow promotes a healthier complexion and contributes to a firmer, smoother appearance.

Throughout the treatment, you’ll experience a sense of deep relaxation as tension melts away and your body feels rejuvenated.

Skin loses elasticity for many reasons, most common are hectic lifestyle, environmental damage and aging. Restore firmness with this Body Massage with Collagen Peptides which uses firming massage strokes with a collagen cream to massage in active ingredients that promote circulation for firmer, smoother skin.
